method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.behavior: Delayed delete (time; self = a ghosted entity): self ghost() (native ghost state); self endon( #"death" ); wait time; self delete(). Used for temp smoke props.

Positional smoke sound sequence(position,duration,startsound,stopsound,loopsound). Request spawn(script_origin,(0,0,1)). Only if smokesound is defined, install smokesound endon(death), reposition its origin, conditionally request startsound and loopsound, wait duration-0.5 only when duration>0.5, conditionally launch thread sound::play_in_space(stopsound,position), request smokesound stoploopsound(0.5), always wait0.5 on this continuing guarded path, then request deletion. An undefined spawn skips every post-spawn operation and falls through. For ordinary finite numeric duration<=0.5 the initial wait is skipped but the final0.5 wait remains; for duration>0.5 the requested source waits are duration-0.5 then0.5. Endon/errors/scheduling can stop or alter actual timing; no exact audio fade, playback or native lifetime outcome is proved.
unknowns: Sound aliases passed from statweapon.projsmoke* fields (weapon data)

summary.behavior: Smoke detonation core (owner, statweapon, smokeweapon, position, radius, effectlifetime, smokeblockduration). effectlifetime defaults 10 when undefined. ent = spawntimedfx( smokeweapon, position, ( 0, 0, 1 ), int( effectlifetime ) ) (native timed FX - the smoke cloud); when owner defined: ent setteam( owner.team ) and (when owner is a player) ent setowner( owner ) (team/ownership filter for the smoke entity). Threads on the ent: smokeblocksight( smokeweapon, radius ) (unit 349) and spawnsmokegrenadetrigger( smokeweapon, smokeblockduration, owner ) (unit 351). When owner defined: owner.smokegrenadetime = gettime(); owner.smokegrenadeposition = position (thrower memory consumed by other systems). Sound: thread playsmokesound( position, smokeblockduration, statweapon.projsmokestartsound, .projsmokeendsound, .projsmokeloopsound ) (unit 360). Returns ent.
unknowns: spawntimedfx with a weapon asset creates the smoke visual/damage data natively
